mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO favorites (user_id, item_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.tags, i.author, i.hot_score, i.ctr, i.publish_time, i.url, i.summary FROM favorites f JOIN items i ON f.item_id = i.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
